newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end sharply lower, near lows.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end sharply lower, near lows.

text.p: May 27 - IMM currency futures ended sharply lower, most near lows. Yen, marks off more late on signs of fund sales. Can dollar fell further despite talk of more Bank of Canada intervention. Swiss off on ideas SNB unhappy with Swiss strength, could cut rates. Marks down on concern post-election French government could back less-selective EMU entry. Technicals added weight.
